On every non-cached refresh the coordinator serializes that struct to a JSON value ([L641][c641]) and writes it as one JSONB job row through `save_job` ([L656][c656]). When a miner reconnects to the other frontend, resume decodes the whole record ([L1466-L1470][c1466]).
